place_fields.summary: Dyamavva Devi temple in Bagalkot’s Killa neighbourhood; the deity is regarded as the presiding deity of Bagalkot city.
place_fields.best_time: During the local jathre/festival period; festival arrangements are subject to local schedules.

planning_attributes.description: A Dyamavva Devi temple in the Killa area of Bagalkot, Karnataka.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Residents of Bagalkot regard Dyamavva Devi as the city’s presiding deity; an annual jathre tradition was discussed for revival after a long interruption.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow local temple instructions and community arrangements when visiting.
planning_attributes.notes: Trip.com lists Dyamavva Temple at 5PJ7+XP5, Bagalkot, Karnataka 587101; Times of India places the Dyamavva Devi temple in the Killa neighbourhood of Bagalkot city.
